entry_state: Product-region witnesses preserve numeric margins but not an invented interpretation of qualitative mix. The entity exhibit supports partial membership and incorporation facts while leaving ownership, tax and functional currencies open. Legal proceedings preserve remedy, jurisdiction, stage and information dates rather than reducing everything to a booked loss. Section2.17 has begun distinguishing planned adoption from later comparative disclosures; its table and temporal consequences follow.

findings.judgment: The later Americas comparative reconciles 167045−89587−9802=67656. It adds expense detail about the same fiscal2024 period without implying new2024 transactions. The changed corporate expense label and exact-version availability remain separate unresolved matters.

No material change to estimates is not constancy of balances. Third-party indemnities can cost Apple, defence can cost money even after a successful claim, and insurance requires its own terms and recognition treatment; the narrative does not net these into one damages amount.

Regulatory restrictions alter feasible delivery and sourcing choices. Demand loss, unavailable components and recovery dates require different histories. The text identifies products, orders, capacity, routes and contract facts instead of turning risk wording into a common percentage shock.

The adoption table, single arithmetic display and long risk discussions remain legible at normal resolution. Reported plans, observed adoption, later comparative facts and assumed future histories are distinguished; reading these pages does not independently establish operative accounting authority.

sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.entry_belief: The earlier proceedings discussion names direct legal exposures but contracts can transmit another party's claim.

sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.belief_update: Apple may owe an indemnified party; successful defence can still incur cost; settlements may change royalties and offerings. Each needs its own terms, dates and recognition facts.
sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.exit_question: When, and to what extent, could insurance recover a separately measured loss?
sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.removal_verdict: A model restricted to cases naming Apple or to the damages outcome would omit distinct cash and operating consequences.
sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.swap_verdict: It builds on the earlier remedy/stage distinctions before the broader regulatory and disruption channels.
sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.entry_verdict: The direction of indemnification is explained before listing the unknown covered conduct and triggers.
sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.exit_verdict: The insurance subsection and interim incorporation statement close the account without merging the channels.

sections/apple-litigation-risk.tex:secti.distinct_contribution_verdict: Loss outcomes, defence expenditure and continuing settlement effects are separate economic histories.

sections/apple-regulation.tex:section:1.entry_belief: Legal risk has been traced through losses and recoveries, but restrictions can prevent delivery itself.
sections/apple-regulation.tex:section:1.open_question: What makes an assumed import delay an operationally meaningful scenario?
sections/apple-regulation.tex:section:1.parent_contribution: Connects regulation to the feasible sourcing, production and delivery plan.
sections/apple-regulation.tex:section:1.belief_update: Measure, effective date, legal scope, affected product/entity, routes, lead times and feasible responses determine whether sales are delayed, rerouted or lost. Repeated risk wording and expanded subjects do not establish unchanged law or a new legal event.
sections/apple-regulation.tex:section:1.exit_question: Even with an open supply route, will customers still want the product?
sections/apple-regulation.tex:section:1.removal_verdict: The mechanism would be incomplete if all regulation were represented as a fine or a uniform sales reduction.

sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.entry_belief: A feasible delivery route alone does not establish demand, and willing customers do not establish component availability.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.open_question: Which historical and scenario relationships distinguish demand loss, supply interruption and recovery?
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.parent_contribution: Explains why joint economic histories need product, supplier, capacity, customer and timing relationships beyond financial balances.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.belief_update: Reduced orders with an open route and unchanged orders with a blocked component need different responses. Recovery spending, restored capacity, deliveries and settlement can occur at different dates.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.exit_question: How should the representation retain these reported assertions and analyst assumptions without conflating them?
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.removal_verdict: The example supplies an operating reason that identical reported totals can conceal different future paths.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.swap_verdict: Regulatory route restrictions introduce feasibility first; the two demand/supply histories then expose what that alone misses.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.entry_verdict: The first two sentences make customer demand and ability to supply distinct before presenting the risk passages.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.exit_verdict: Reported resources constrain histories without determining the response; the close returns to separate source facts, interpreted relationships and assumptions.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.promise_verdict: No facility hazard rates, common percentage shock, joint probability law or immediate recovery is fabricated.
sections/apple-disruption.tex:section:1.distinct_contribution_verdict: Ending a disruption need not immediately restore production, sales or cash, so recovery has its own dated mechanism.

exit_state: Later segment comparatives add dated disclosure detail without creating new prior-year transactions or proving historical availability. Materially unchanged estimates and risk wording do not freeze amounts. Indemnity, defence, settlement, insurance recovery and regulation have distinct contractual and operating channels. Demand, component availability and recovery timing preserve different histories behind the same balances; the next representation must retain those facts and assumptions separately.
